status: Post hoc sensitivity analysis designed after observing differing available-case and fixed-patient trajectories; not a new primary trial analysis.
primary_sensitivity_scope: CAMS: all three initial groups have measured follow-up IgE
additional_scope: All 163 clinical patients; requires borrowing follow-up patterns across centres, including unobserved Huashan dupilumab follow-up cells

imputation.method: Patient-wide fully conditional specification; Bayesian normal regression draws with residual-variance uncertainty and type-1 predictive mean matching
imputation.donor_pool: Same variable, nominal visit and initial treatment; 5 nearest predictive-mean donors
imputation.cross_wave_predictors: All other incomplete variables; clinical EASI imputations are auxiliary draws only and never saved as validation truth

estimates.within_group: Means and paired changes on log(1+IgE), Rubin pooled with Barnard-Rubin small-sample degrees of freedom; back-transformed levels are shifted geometric means
estimates.adjusted_contrasts: W12/W24 log(1+IgE) ANCOVA with baseline log(1+IgE), initial treatment by visit, baseline EASI, age, sex, BMI and centre if variable; patient-cluster robust covariance; existing baseline overlap weights held fixed
estimates.all_paired: Every available pair for each interval, patient-paired t interval on log(1+IgE)
estimates.fixed_triplets: Same observed W0/W12/W24 patients, shown separately rather than assumed unbiased

MNAR_sensitivity.interpretation: Multiply 1+IgE by 0.5 or 2 only for imputed W12/W24 observations, truncate negative resulting IgE at zero; measured values and imputed W0 stay unchanged. Scenarios are illustrative, not estimated facts.

boundaries: Repeated 5000 values are retained as recorded, not declared an assay ceiling

method_sensitivity_amendment.reason: Initial PMM versus available-data longitudinal model diverged for abrocitinib 200 mg; low-baseline missing-followup patients have limited same-treatment donor support. Both methods are retained, without selecting a direction.
method_sensitivity_amendment.additional_method: Bayesian normal FCS for natural-log IgE, converted to log(1+IgE) for the unchanged analysis; EASI auxiliary variables remain PMM. No upper bound or assumed 5000 assay ceiling is imposed.
method_sensitivity_amendment.tails: Report positive imputed values outside the observed range; these diagnose extrapolation rather than measured biology.

computation_amendment: Increased burn-in to200 cycles, spacing to10 cycles and retained imputations to400 after the Gaussian sensitivity had split R-hat1.13 and MonteCarlo SE16.6% of inferential SE; direction was not used to choose run length.
